about: A girl dragged out of a special cell (DAIRY, GIANT, CHAINS, LILITH SHRINE) onto an occupied cell swaps places with the girl there, who goes into the special cell. Vanilla refused every swap between different classes, so two mod girls the shrine lets in (Hathorverse's Lili variants in the Lili Temple) could not swap. The swap is now allowed when the special cell is the other girl's own cell, and still refused when it is not.
